en: Black‑and‑white (with red caption) historic view of a street lined with brick and plaster buildings forming the entrance area to a military barracks complex. On the right side stand multi‑storey barracks buildings behind a low brick wall with trees; to the left are more walls, a small guard pavilion, and a tall pole or tower with insulators, likely for telegraph or lighting. Several small figures, possibly soldiers and civilians, are seen near the gate. The red printed caption at the top identifies the location as the entrance to the infantry barracks in Wurzen.
